title: Memory Loss
description: Every few minutes, you forget a random crafting recipe. Can you survive when you no longer remember how to craft essential tools, furnaces, or even chests?
body:
# Memory Loss (Fabric)

Have you ever wondered if you could beat Minecraft if you suddenly forgot how to craft basic survival blocks? **Memory Loss** is a survival challenge mod where your memory degrades over time, making you forget random recipes!

---

## How It Works
Once the challenge is activated, a background timer starts ticking. Every few minutes (default: 5 minutes, fully customizable), you will suddenly forget how to craft a random item. 

* **Complete Crafting Block:** When you forget a recipe, it disappears from your Recipe Book. Additionally, **you cannot craft it manually** in either a Crafting Table (3x3) or your inventory (2x2). The output slot will simply remain empty!
* **Visual HUD:** A clean indicator in the top-left corner keeps track of how many recipes you have forgotten.
* **Network Sync:** Perfectly optimized for multiplayer! The server tells your client exactly what has been forgotten, preventing any desyncs or ghost items.

---

## Difficulty Levels
Customize the challenge to fit your playstyle:
* **EASY:** The mod will only make you forget weapons, tools, and armor (swords, pickaxes, helmets, shields, etc.).
* **NORMAL:** Anything can be forgotten except for the absolute essentials: Crafting Tables, Furnaces, Chests, and Torches are safe.
* **HARDCORE:** No mercy. Absolutely any recipe in the game can be lost at any moment.

---

## Operator Commands (OP Level 2)
You can manage the challenge on the fly using the following commands:
* `/memory start` — Starts the timer and begins the memory loss challenge.
* `/memory stop` — Pauses the challenge.
* `/memory difficulty <easy/normal/hardcore>` — Dynamically shifts the pool of forgettable recipes.
* `/memory delay <seconds>` — Adjusts how often players forget recipes (e.g., `/memory delay 300` for 5 minutes).
* `/memory status` — Shows the current state of the game, current difficulty, interval, and how many recipes you have personally forgotten.
* `/memory reset` — Restores the memory of all players and unlocks all their recipes.

---

## Requirements & Installation
* **Minecraft Version:** 1.21 / 1.21.1
* **Mod Loader:** Fabric Loader (>=0.15.0)
* **Required Dependency:** [Fabric API](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fabric-api)

*This mod is fully client-server synchronized. It is recommended to install it on both the server and client for the best experience (visual indicators, recipe book clearing).*
